name: AzerothCore
author: sintheticgaming@gmail.com
description: AzerothCore 3.3.5a server using a precompiled community Pelican runtime and an external MySQL 8.0 database.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl unzip ca-certificates
fi

CLIENT_DATA_VERSION="v20.0"
CLIENT_DATA_URL="https://github.com/wowgaming/client-data/releases/download/${CLIENT_DATA_VERSION}/data.zip"

INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
DATA_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}/data"
VERSION_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/data-version"
ZIP_FILE="${INSTALL_DIR}/client-data.zip"

echo "Installing AzerothCore client data ${CLIENT_DATA_VERSION}..."

mkdir -p "${DATA_DIR}"

INSTALLED_VERSION=""

if [[ -f "${VERSION_FILE}" ]]; then
    # The version file is expected to contain:
    # INSTALLED_VERSION=vX.Y
    source "${VERSION_FILE}"
fi

if [[ "${INSTALLED_VERSION:-}" == "${CLIENT_DATA_VERSION}" ]]; then
    echo "Client data ${CLIENT_DATA_VERSION} is already installed."
    echo "Skipping download."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Downloading client data..."
curl --fail --location \
    "${CLIENT_DATA_URL}" \
    --output "${ZIP_FILE}"

echo "Extracting client data..."
unzip -q -o "${ZIP_FILE}" -d "${DATA_DIR}"

rm -f "${ZIP_FILE}"

printf 'INSTALLED_VERSION=%s\n' "${CLIENT_DATA_VERSION}" > "${VERSION_FILE}"

echo "Client data ${CLIENT_DATA_VERSION} installed successfully."
